performance.timing: Measured before final constant-cost fixes for blocked response expiry and Dash input ownership; final behavior covered by focused tests and browser input/ability checks.
performance.limits: RTX 5070 desktop, five-second live samples, not deterministic combat replay or a low-end guarantee. One 33.9ms frame occurred during floor activity. Defense p95 was 21.6ms. Budgets were unchanged; this does not establish hitch-free gameplay.

correctedFixtureAssumptions: The friendly-passability fixture now maintains its desired input each frame; it no longer expects persistent operative coasting after one external velocity assignment.
The movement fixture reserves the actual staged-obstacle footprint plus clearance instead of requiring an unnecessarily wide empty runway unavailable in some fortress layouts.
limitations: A response lasts 0.1 physics seconds; existing detonation cadence can make that shorter in real time.
Input overrides collision response; a free Dash retains its authored timing until collision or normal completion.
Existing broad-phase and sweep budgets bound extra contacts under extreme crowding. Existing overlap/contact-damage handling remains authoritative.
Dedicated rebound audio remains unassigned pending an asset. No audio or save-schema change.
Automated checks verify responsiveness and containment; subjective movement feel still benefits from player feedback.
